doubts: The page does not say the main way returns; DOC's distance says 'one way', so it is recorded as one way ending at Angelus Hut. Start ref F1 is where Speargrass Track (the first track) meets Mt Robert Road at the car park. For the loop (W2), the return on Pinchgut Track reaches Mt Robert Road at a different road end (F2); the text says it returns to the same Mt Robert carpark, so F1 is used for both start and end. The lake is not named.
